verdict.rationale: INPI publishes task-oriented guidance pages for founders' procedures (filing a trademark, choosing goods and services for a mark, online patent filing, the software special case, provisional patent applications, e-Soleau). It also offers an awareness and training programme through Académie INPI. The evidence is only page titles, so the plain-language, step-by-step nature of the content is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: verbatim evidence that the pages contain non-lawyer, step-by-step walkthroughs; any independent or hands-on confirmation that founders can follow them without legal help.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
